scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix caregiver-app install && npm --prefix admin-web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow" -n "api,fam,car,adm" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:family" "npm run dev:caregiver" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan" -n "api,fam,car,adm,prx" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:family" "npm run dev:caregiver" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:proxy"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix caregiver-app run build && npm --prefix admin-web run build
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -b && npm --prefix caregiver-app exec tsc -b && npm --prefix admin-web exec tsc -b
